entries.en: I can't believe most of these buildings are still standing after 50,000 years.
I can see why people keep trying to colonize this world. Most of the infrastructure is still intact.
All this rubble makes good cover for snipers.
These ruins are crawling with vermin -- organic and synthetic.
The geth have brought ruin to this world. As they do to every world.
This city was once a marvel of Prothean technology. Now it's nothing but a graveyard.
You've brokered a far gentler resolution than many colonies manage.
ExoGeni Corp. appreciates your cooperation in securing its colonial assets.
Glad we didn't get on your bad side.
Colonization projects are inherently dangerous.
The frontier is a lot more dangerous than most people realize.
I'm glad this didn't get ugly.
Your handling of ExoGeni was impressive.
Everyone here could have been swept under the rug.
Colonial Affairs doesn't pay much attention to the real frontier.
In a few weeks, none of the colonists will remember this planet even exists.
This sort of deal doesn't happen often.
Not a bad outcome. Everyone wins.
I never expected this. Never expected you either, Shepard.
Colonization is risky. Not always for the reasons people choose to believe.
These people had their shot. That's more than some get.
The Board doesn't open its accounts for just anyone.
Scouts. They'll be here any minute now.
I don't know how much more I can take.
The last batch went south. What are they looking for?
We're picking up a comm signal. It's weak, but there's definitely someone out here.
Got some kind of comm signal. It's too weak to pinpoint, but someone is definitely out here.
We are receiving a weak comm signal. I cannot pinpoint its location through the geth interference.
I'm picking up a comm signal. It's too weak to pinpoint, but there's definitely someone out here.
We're receiving a weak comm signal. I can't pinpoint its location through the geth interference.
More chatter, Commander Shepard. I still can't get a fix on the location.
More on the comm, Commander, but I still can't get a fix on it.
More communication, Commander, but I am still unable to pinpoint its origin.
More chatter, Commander. Still no fix.
More chatter incoming, Commander. Still no fix.
Any sign of movement? Lizbeth could still be in there. It's only been a few days.
She's my daughter. I'll wait as long as I have to.
We've got movement... some kind of vehicle. Not one of the geth.
They've got us on visual. We must be close.
They're not our concern. We need to find those geth.
Shouldn't we be more concerned about the geth?
Forget them. We need to deal with the geth.
We should deal with the geth first.
Dealing with the geth is more important.
They've seen us. They must be nearby.
Sounds like they've spotted us. They must be close.
They must be close enough to see us.
Whoever that is, they must be close to have seen us.
They're coming right for us. Damn it! Is this comm unshielded? Son of a b--
We seem to have alarmed them.
We seem to have caused some concern.
That got their attention.
Sounds like that got their attention.
Well, we won't be surprising them.
It's moving off, right to the ExoGeni headquarters.
Proceed to WAR40(refugee camp) or WAR50(ExoGeni building/geth base)
WAR40 (refugee camp)
WAR50(ExoGeni/geth base)
Forget them. We need to find the geth.
Those poor fools are in for a nasty surprise.
